letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Junior Software Engineer role at Example Hiring Team. I am completing a BSc in Computer Science and have gained hands-on software development experience through Booking Lab, an independent appointment scheduler built with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

While developing Booking Lab, I implemented persistent storage and automated tests for booking conflicts. I also documented the trade-off between database constraints and application-level validation and created a reproducible local demo. This work strengthened my ability to reason about application behaviour, test important scenarios, and communicate technical decisions clearly. Although my record does not specify API-level testing, the project has given me a practical foundation in Node.js and automated testing that I would be keen to extend to API test design.

My previous work as a Programme Coordinator developed complementary skills that I would bring to an engineering team. I coordinated appointment schedules, documented conflict resolution for colleagues, and collected accessibility feedback from programme participants. That experience taught me to approach systems from the user’s perspective and to record issues carefully. Combined with my React experience, it provides a useful foundation for learning and applying established accessible-interface practices.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute as a junior engineer while continuing to develop my skills in API testing, accessible frontend implementation, and operational tooling. I do not yet have documented Kubernetes operations experience, but I am prepared to learn it as part of the role. I would bring curiosity, careful documentation, practical project experience, and a collaborative mindset to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I would be pleased to discuss Booking Lab and how my technical studies and coordination experience could support Example Hiring Team.

Sincerely,
Zoë Șerban
